caption: A raw red steak is laid in a hot pan, and its surface turns from red to grey-brown from the edges inward while it sizzles.

sa.check: A raw red steak is laid in a hot pan.
The steak's surface turns from red to grey-brown.
The change spreads from the edges inward.
The change starts where the meat touches the pan.
The laying down comes first and the colour change follows.

pc.expect: The colour change only advances inward and the changed surface does not turn red again; the steak only shrinks.
pc.fail: A greyed part turns red again in the hot pan; or the change spreads and then retreats; or the steak grows in the pan; or the change starts in the middle of the top face and works outward to the edges.

pc.expect: The change happens in the meat where it touches the hot pan and at its edges, and the pan's surface stays as it was.
pc.fail: The pan's surface changes colour rather than the steak; or the steak's upper face greys while the side on the metal stays red; or the steak is grey-brown before it reaches the pan; or the whole steak changes colour in a single frame with no spreading.

pc.expect: The steak lies in the pan and any juices run to its low places and pool.
pc.fail: The steak lifts off the pan and hangs; or the juices climb the pan's wall and stay; or the juices gather on top of the steak and stay; or the steak slides uphill in a tilted pan.

pc.expect: The steak is a soft solid that stiffens and shrinks a little, staying one slab, and the juices are a thin liquid.
pc.fail: The steak melts into a liquid; or the steak shatters; or the steak stretches longer as it cooks; or the juices set into a rigid crust that stands off the pan.

pc.expect: One steak in one pan; the steak stays one piece and none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A second steak appears; or the steak vanishes; or the steak splits into two whole steaks; or the steak passes through the pan's floor.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The steak's colour change is the caption's asserted outcome; the chemistry of it is not judged, only that it runs one way and starts where the meat meets the pan.
